summary: NetEase, Inc. furnished a Form 6-K attaching a Hong Kong Stock Exchange Next Day Disclosure Return dated November 3, 2026, reporting routine movements in issued and treasury shares. On November 2, 2026 the company repurchased 5,180 ordinary shares into treasury at USD 22.864 per share, a 0.0002% change, leaving 3,201,470,116 issued shares and 10,585,540 treasury shares, total 3,212,055,656. The filing is an ordinary buyback disclosure rather than a special situation; watch cumulative repurchase pace and treasury ADS overhang, with no deal terms or risk-arb angle present.
